items.description: The Insurance Act was passed, which is the foundational law for all insurance business in India.
Promulgation of ordinance for the nationalization of life insurance business in India.

items.title: 1956 (LIC Act)
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) Act was passed.
LIC of India came into being with its Central Office at Mumbai.
General Insurance Business (Nationalisation) Act was passed (GIBNA).
Notification of establishment of Insurance Ombudsman.
IRDAI Act was passed to establish a statutory body to regulate and develop the insurance industry.

items.title: April 2000
items.description: IRDA got statutory body status for Life, Non-Life, and Health Insurance Industry.
Supreme Court judgment relating to HLV (Human Life Value) of a person.

items.title: November 2010
items.description: As per IRDA Circular, all Universal Life products to be known as Variable Insurance Products (VIP).

items.title: 15 Days
items.description: For Underwriter to decide based on a proposal.

items.title: 30 Days
items.description: Free Look-in Period (latest IRDAI guidelines — increased from 15 to 30 days in 2024).

items.title: 90 Days (3 months)
items.description: For Ombudsman to pass an award.
